What is Plus AI?

AI presentation add-on that works natively inside Google Slides and PowerPoint rather than as a separate platform - you generate, edit and remix slides without leaving the tool your organisation already standardises on.

Best for

AI deck generation that produces genuinely native Google Slides or PowerPoint files.

Main features

  • Generate a full deck from a prompt or uploaded document inside Google Slides or PowerPoint
  • Rewrite and Remix existing slides
  • custom templates that the AI respects, including your corporate template
  • insert AI-generated charts and diagrams
  • Snapshots pulling live data from dashboards into slides and keeping it updated
  • AI editing of individual slides
  • team template sharing.

Practical use cases

  • Generating a first-draft deck that stays in your corporate PowerPoint template
  • converting a document into slides without leaving Google Slides
  • refreshing recurring reporting decks with live dashboard snapshots
  • polishing an existing deck slide by slide.

Who is it for?

  • Organisations standardised on Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 who must deliver native deck files.

Pricing, free access & limits

Per-seat subscription; freemium trial

Plans described in the source

Free trial with a limited number of AI presentations. Basic around $10-15/user/mo. Pro around $20-25/user/mo billed annually with custom templates, unlimited generation and Snapshots. Business/Enterprise around $35+/user/mo with admin controls, SSO and shared template libraries. Annual billing discounted. Verify current tiers directly.

Free plan

Limited free trial allowance rather than a permanent free plan.

Free trial

Yes - free trial with a limited number of AI-generated presentations.

Usage limits to consider

Generation counts limited on lower tiers; custom template support and Snapshots are higher-tier features. Requires a Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 account.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • Output is a real native file - this is the decisive advantage over Gamma for organisations where the deliverable must be an editable PPTX or Google Slides deck
  • respects your existing corporate template rather than imposing its own design
  • Snapshots keeping live data current in recurring decks is a genuinely useful and underrated feature
  • no new tool for the team to learn.

Limitations to consider

  • Design quality is bounded by your template and by Google Slides itself, so output is less visually impressive than Gamma
  • the add-on model means performance depends on the host application
  • fewer creative features
  • smaller company
  • pricing is not always clearly published
  • requires the host suite.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Google Slides add-on, PowerPoint add-in, web app

Languages

  • Generates in multiple languages including Arabic and French; inherits the host application's RTL support, which is better than most standalone tools

API access

Limited; enterprise integrations available

Integrations and exports

  • Google Slides, Google Drive, PowerPoint, Microsoft 365, Looker, Tableau, Google Analytics, Salesforce (via Snapshots)

Evaluation notes

Choose Plus AI over Gamma when the deliverable format matters more than the visual polish - most corporate and client work falls into this category. Test with your actual corporate template during the trial.
